Face: Short dark-gray hair combed upward, strong angular eyebrows, pronounced nose and smile lines, clean-shaven, no glasses. Pose: head and eyes turned 50 degrees toward the right, both eyes looking right, shoulders slightly counter-turned, holding a slim closed folder below chest level. Clothing: a formal charcoal tailored suit, pale shirt and sober dark blue silk tie. Background: an institutional press lectern with cobalt light and bronze architectural details. No microphone. BOTTOM LEFT: Valéry Giscard d’Estaing. Face: Very high bald forehead with fine gray hair at the sides, long narrow face and pronounced curved nose, clean-shaven, no glasses. Pose: head and eyes turned 45 degrees toward the left, head slightly raised and both eyes toward the upper left side of the chamber, one restrained speaking hand. Clothing: a formal dark navy tailored suit, white shirt and restrained patterned silk tie. Background: a European parliamentary library, amber light, deep green leather and tall architectural depth. Include one or two low lectern microphones, never across the face. BOTTOM RIGHT: Lionel Jospin. Face: Thick softly curly white hair, pale eyebrows, rectangular thin metal glasses, long nose, clean-shaven. Pose: head and eyes turned 40 degrees toward the right, chin slightly lowered, both eyes following an unseen interlocutor to the right, calm attentive posture. Clothing: a formal dark blue tailored suit, pale blue shirt and subdued violet silk tie. Background: a parliamentary corridor with cool daylight, stone columns and softly blurred burgundy benches.
